# Exhaust system upgrades and mufflers

> **[Unverified]** This page rests on a single community report. Cross-check before relying on it.

## Summary

Remove the old exhaust, drill out broken studs if necessary, and install a new muffler with specific diameters. [t43]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Every step below is supported by the source, but the verifier could not confirm this is the whole procedure. Steps or precautions may be missing; read the source thread before relying on it.

1. Remove the old exhaust, noting that studs between secondary cats often break.
2. Drill out any broken stud remnants and replace them with a nut and bolt if necessary.

_Procedure reported by [t43]._

## Tips & gotchas

- Soak all studs in penetrating oil well before removal. [t43]
- Consider using a reciprocating saw with a fresh metal cutting blade for easier disassembly. [t43]
